question.value: Can the oxygen isotope ratios (especially 18O/17O) of molecular gas in the low-metallicity SMC be measured via C18O and C17O J=2-1 and what do they say about stellar enrichment and the galaxy-wide IMF

evidence.quote: Oxygen isotope abundances and their ratios are fingerprints of stellar evolution and therefore provide a powerful tool in tracing the enrichment history of galaxies.
Precise measurements of the gas-phase $^{18}$O/$^{17}$O isotope ratios in the SMC will yield important insight into its chemical evolution

C18O and C17O taken from ACA-only data; missing flux for them is argued, not measured (TP did not detect C18O)
